en.headline: Security chief says legislative reforms on fire safety are forthcoming
en.dek: Chris Tang told a radio programme that administrative measures already taken would be followed by legislative changes after the Tai Po fire report.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said on Friday that the government would roll out a series of legislative reforms to improve fire safety, following the independent committee’s report on the deadly Wang Fuk Court fire.

Speaking on a radio programme, Tang said authorities had already introduced a series of administrative measures over the past year. He noted that further legislative changes were pending and that the Fire Services Department had acknowledged ultimate responsibility for fire safety.

Tang said that if anyone filed a complaint about a fire-related situation, the department must follow up until another department took over, even if it was not its direct responsibility. On accountability, he pointed to the Chief Executive’s earlier statement that anyone found to bear responsibility for the blaze would be held to account.

The independent committee submitted its report to Chief Executive John Lee on Thursday. Lee has said plans for comprehensive reforms would be announced shortly. The full report has not yet been released to the public.

zh.headline: 保安局長指消防安全立法改革即將推出
zh.dek: 鄧炳強在電台節目表示，過去一年已採取行政措施，隨大埔火災報告提交後將有立法改革。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周五表示，政府將推出一系列立法改革以提升消防安全，回應旺福邨致命火災後獨立委員會提交的報告。
鄧炳強在電台節目中說，當局過去一年已引入多項行政措施，進一步的立法改變正在籌備。他指出，消防處已確認對消防安全負有終極責任。
鄧炳強表示，任何人就火災相關情況提出投訴，即使不屬消防處直接職責，部門亦須跟進直至另一部門接手。就問責問題，他重申行政長官早前的說法，任何被發現須為火災負責的人士或實體都將被追究責任。
獨立委員會周四將報告提交予行政長官李家超。李家超已表示將儘快公布全面改革計劃。報告全文尚未向公眾公開。
